race.comment: MIGHTY MYRTLE (7) was solid from the back first-up before a nose defeat at Kembla most recently. Guymer now replaces the apprentice hoop and some sting out of the ground won't be an issue. She's a winner at this track and trip previously and this shapes nicely for her to go one better. EPAULLO CREED (3) felt the pinch at Forbes last time when racing over the mile and coming back in trip is a big tick. Loy's booking is a good push for his chances and he should be up front from the outset. Will give plenty of cheek. ROCCO LINI (11) was sound on resumption at Kembla, beaten 3.5L in a sound performance. He still has some upside and he can improve on the fresh run. Boudvillain rides now and he can feature in the finish. SNOWY (12) can improve quickly today and she's won 2/3 fresh. Expecting a better effort. BON FRANKIE (6) can feature on his best form.
